theme.design_archetype: Swiss & Precision Enterprise Trust (Clean light studio with high-fidelity semantic telemetry)
theme.description: Clean white and slate-50 base architecture tailored for ZaYoTm™ Universal Enterprise Intelligence & Trust Platform. Employs crisp 1px borders, data-dense rectangular modules, high-contrast monospace cryptographic hashes, multi-agent telemetry pipelines, classical vs quantum comparison cards, and role-gated approval workflows with emerald (verified), indigo/violet (AI intelligence), cyan/sky (quantum lab), amber (pending approval/simulation), and rose (tamper/anomaly) semantic accents.

entry_surfaces./: Enterprise intelligence console shell — persistent dark navy telemetry sidebar left, sticky capabilities + role switcher topbar, modular multi-panel dashboard right with 12-step guided investor demo runner and live telemetry cards.

navigation_and_layout.shell_structure: Left vertical fixed sidebar (w-64, slate-900 background) with ZaYoTm™ brand lockup, navigation items for all 8 functional modules with badge counters, system health status, and live simulated block height. Top bar (h-16, crisp white border-b border-slate-200) with 3 prominent Capability Badges (Quantum: Simulator, LLM: Connected, Ledger: Dev Simulation), active dataset indicator, and interactive Role Switcher dropdown (Executive, Senior Risk Analyst, Chief Compliance Approver).

screens.label: Executive Overview
screens.description: High-level cockpit: KPI tiles, 12-Step Investor Demo runner with automated step-through, live decision pipeline status, anomaly distribution, recent verified records, and active ledger block height.

screens.label: Data Workspace
screens.description: CSV ingestion, schema inference, automated data-quality profiling (missingness, distribution, outliers, drift score), and enterprise sample dataset loader (Supply Chain Disruption, Cloud Resource Allocation, Financial Portfolio Risk).

screens.label: AI Intelligence Center
screens.description: 10-agent orchestration matrix with live execution traces, reasoning DAG graph, structured evidence citations, confidence intervals, epistemic vs aleatoric uncertainty gauges, and multi-agent conflict resolution logs.

screens.label: Decision Studio
screens.description: Multi-criteria tradeoff engine: objective weight sliders (Cost, Latency, Risk, SLA, ESG), generated alternatives matrix, Pareto frontier visualization, AI rationale inspector, and role-gated multi-signature approval controls.

screens.label: Quantum Lab
screens.description: Direct side-by-side solver benchmark: Classical Exact / OR-Tools MIP vs QAOA on Qiskit Aer Simulator (QUBO formulation, ansatz depth p, shot count, convergence curves, quantum approximation ratio, energy eigenvalues, runtime in ms).

screens.label: Trust & Blockchain Center
screens.description: Immutable decision provenance: SHA-256 cryptographic proof generator, simulated Dev Ledger block explorer (Besu EVM contract interface ready), merkle root verification, interactive 1-click Tamper-Test simulator demonstrating instant cryptographic signature invalidation.

screens.label: Audit Trail & Compliance
screens.description: Chronological enterprise audit log with multidimensional filtering (Actor, Event Type, Severity, Cryptographic Hash), raw JSON telemetry payload inspector, and 1-click regulatory CSV/JSON export.

screens.label: Settings & Capability Matrix
screens.description: System architecture inspector, LLM provider selector (Gemini / Anthropic / Local fallback), Qiskit Aer backend tuning, Besu dev ledger node RPC adapter configuration, and system reset / reseed controls.

visual_enhancers.grid_borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 dividing modular panels, with subtle hover elevation (shadow-sm to shadow-md transition)
visual_enhancers.monospace_hashes: Font-family JetBrains Mono with tracking-wide, highlighted byte prefixes (0x...), copy-to-clipboard buttons, and green/red status beacons
visual_enhancers.telemetry_chips: Clearly labeled state pills: 'SIMULATION [Qiskit Aer]' in cyan, 'LLM [Reasoning + Fallback]' in purple, 'DEV LEDGER [Besu Adapter]' in amber, 'VERIFIED' in emerald
visual_enhancers.interactive_flow_diagrams: Horizontal multi-stage pipeline ribbon (Data -> Ingestion -> 10-Agent AI -> Optimization -> Role Approval -> SHA-256 Hash -> Dev Ledger) with active step indicators for the investor demo
visual_enhancers.data_density: High scanability with compact padding (p-4 to p-6), distinct visual card headers, clear divider lines, and rich metric cards with trend micro-badges.

motion.rules: Restrained, crisp, and purposeful micro-interactions only. No gratuitous spinning 3D or floating bubbles. Use motion/react for state transitions, modal entrances, and step progression indicator animation.
motion.hover_states: translate-y-[-1px] with border-slate-300 and shadow-sm on interactive cards
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All normal text exceeds WCAG AA 4.5:1 against respective backgrounds. Muted text on white panels is #64748B (4.52:1 ratio) or darker #475569. Dark sidebar text #F8FAFC and muted #94A3B8 on #0F172A (exceeds 7:1).
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Interactive elements support standard focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-500 focus-visible:outline-none).
accessibility.testing_attributes: Every button, tab, input, role switch, approval trigger, tamper button, and data upload element MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="demo-step-next-button", data-testid="approve-decision-button", data-testid="tamper-test-trigger").

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Brand Name: Always use 'ZaYoTm™' throughout the application headers, titles, reports, and footer.

2. Theme & Styling: Apply clean white/slate-50 background with crisp slate-200 borders and rich semantic accent tags (Emerald, Cyan, Violet, Amber, Rose). Update frontend/src/index.css with @import '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans'; and @import '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono';

3. Seed Data & Scenarios: Build 3 comprehensive realistic enterprise datasets (Supply Chain Disruption Response, Multi-Cloud Workload Allocation, Financial Portfolio Risk & Liquidity). Ensure demo runs out-of-the-box with rich mock/live data.

4. 12-Step Guided Investor Demo: Implement a prominent, interactive floating/header demo drawer or banner on the Executive Overview that walks an investor step-by-step through: 1) Data Load, 2) Schema Profiling, 3) 10-Agent Execution, 4) Anomaly Detection, 5) Uncertainty Analysis, 6) Multi-Criteria Optimization, 7) Classical vs Quantum QAOA Benchmark, 8) Recommendation Generation, 9) Role-Gated Approval (Analyst/Approver), 10) SHA-256 Decision Anchoring, 11) Tamper Simulation & Verification Test, 12) Audit Trail Inspection.

5. 10 AI Agents Matrix: Accurately display all 10 specialized agents with execution times, status, confidence score, evidence citations, and conflict resolutions: Data Ingestion Agent, Anomaly Scout Agent, Risk Evaluation Agent, Constraint Reasoning Agent, Quantum Formulation Agent, Optimization Arbiter Agent, Uncertainty Calibration Agent, Explainability & Rationale Agent, Governance & Compliance Agent, and Cryptographic Ledger Agent.

6. Quantum Lab: Include realistic QUBO formulation visualizations, circuit depth parameters (p=1..4), shots (100..2048), Qiskit Aer statevector simulation logs, classical OR-Tools MIP metrics, objective value convergence chart (Recharts), runtime comparison (e.g. Classical 42ms vs Quantum Sim 185ms), and quantum approximation ratio.

7. Trust & Blockchain Center: Provide realistic SHA-256 hash generation on decision payloads, simulated Besu dev ledger blocks with transaction hashes, block explorer table, and an interactive 'Tamper Decision Data' button that alters a single byte, immediately triggering cryptographic hash mismatch and a red alert banner.

8. Role-Based Permissions: Demo identity switcher in top bar for 'Executive (View & Override)', 'Risk Analyst (Run Analysis & Draft)', 'Chief Compliance Approver (Final Sign-off)'. Disable or require switching roles when approving high-risk decisions.
9. Reliability: Ensure the frontend renders resilient fallback states if backend API endpoints take time or are offline, guaranteeing a zero-crash investor experience.
10. Test IDs: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key data display elements.
